title: Senior PowerBI engineer
full_description:
ING Hubs Poland is hiring!
The expected salary for this position: 13 000 - 20 000 PLN gross
The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations.
We are looking for you, if you:
arehighly skilled and experienced Data Analyst & BI Consultant
have proven experience indata analysis,data modelling, andconsultancy
possess hands-on expertise withPower BI Cloud– including dashboard creation, data modelling, and RLS.
have experience withdata warehouses,data quality, andsemantic modelling.
can manage complex data projects and integrated datasets.
demonstrate excellent communication and storytelling skills
have a collaborative mindset and a passion for sharing knowledge.
You'll get extra points for:
understanding ofaccounting principlesand financial processes.
Your responsibilities:
data Exploration & Modelling:analyze and process data for BI purposes,design and implement semantic data models.
analyze and process data for BI purposes,

BI Development & Reporting:own and manage the reporting environment,create and maintain models, reports, and implementRow-Level Security (RLS),develop compelling, story-driven dashboards usingPower BI Cloud.

Information about the squad:
Our squad supports an application that is a cutting-edge finance management solution designed to centralize and streamline accounting processes across multiple entities and GAAP standards. It supports:
Multi-entity and multi-GAAP accountingwith detailed balances in various currencies.
End-to-end automationof accounting workflows, accelerating financial close and ensuring regulatory compliance.
Advanced features such asdouble-entry accounting,drill-down reporting, andconfigurable period-end processing.
The role naming convention in the global ING job architecture will be “Engineer IV”.
